turns.replyText:
If I cancel, how long until I'm refunded?
If your order or an item within your order is canceled, you will not be charged. When you place an order, a payment authorization hold is placed on your account to verify funds. You are only charged once your order ships. If you used a debit or check card, the authorization may appear as a pending charge, and these funds are typically released by your bank within 3 to 5 business days, but it may take up to 30 days depending on your financial institution. For credit cards, the authorization hold may remain visible for up to 30 days before it is automatically removed.
If you paid with a gift card or digital gift card, a new digital gift card will be issued to you, and you will receive an email with a new code within 2 business days of the cancellation.
The exact timing depends on your bank or card issuer, as we cannot expedite this process.
